What this site provides.

Morrowfield Academy is an original fictional identity used for this educational landing experience. It is not an operating school, accredited institution or admissions service. No campus, school record, qualification or enrollment is offered.

Learning suggestions are general information. Select materials appropriate to the learner and seek guidance from a qualified teacher when needed. External resources are controlled by their respective providers; availability and suitability are not guaranteed.

Use resources with care.

Respect applicable law, the rights of others and the rules of your actual school or network. Do not submit personal, student, financial or confidential information to this demonstration. Follow the license or rights notice attached to each linked resource.

The software and material are provided without warranties, to the extent permitted by applicable law. Nothing on this page removes rights you may have under applicable law.

Open-source notices.

This landing experience is part of Heavenly Node, an open-source project released under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3. The project builds on node-unblocker by Nathan Friedly, with Heavenly improvements by Syshi and contributors.

Your session, your choice.

Opening Terms of Service unlocks the main application for this browser tab’s session, preserving the established landing-page behavior. The terms remain here so you can read them before continuing.

The optional timed entry preference is unchanged. Visiting Academy pages later does not reset your bookmarks, settings or unlocked session.

Information pages & your launch choice.

Our approach, Terms of Service, Privacy, Accessibility and Credits follow the saved Search launch preferences in Settings. They open in the same tab by default. The Search new-tab choice opens a normal new tab; Search about:blank opens these local information pages inside a separate about:blank tab. Learning guides and external resource links keep ordinary browser navigation.

If your browser blocks a new tab, the selected page opens in the current tab. In an about:blank tab, Back returns through information pages or to Academy home, and Open normally opens the current document directly. Academy home, external links and Continue to Heavenly open their destination in that tab.
